newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Stock trading uncertain in Dhaka bourse.
newsitem.headline: Stock trading uncertain in Dhaka bourse.

text.p: It is unclear if the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) will trade following clashes between kerb market operators and police on Wednesday, brokers said.
"We will remain open during business hours, but whether trading will take place depends on the situation," DSE Chairman Imtiyaz Husain said.
Police fired teargas and used batons to subdue violent punters angry at the fall in share prices on the kerb market.
The DSE all-share price index closed 2.73 percent down at 3,298.04 on a turnover of 166.4 million taka on Wednesday.
